_comment: Copy the values you need to ~/.sundial/config.json — that's the only config file Gnomon reads (packages/helpers/src/sundial-config.ts), not a repo-root one. Every field is optional; a missing file or a partially-filled one are both completely valid.

privacy._sensitiveApps_comment: Additive — appended to the built-in sensitive-app list, never a replacement. Matched against the process name.
privacy._hiddenApps_comment: Additive. For these process names the free text, paths and URLs become [hidden] at ingest; the event and its time are kept.
privacy._shellRedactPatterns_comment: Additive regex strings (Go/PCRE-style (?i) prefix for case-insensitive), appended to the built-in password/token/bearer patterns.

_budgets_comment: Per-purpose daily LLM call cap overrides, e.g. { "extract": 100 }. Only recognized purposes with a positive number take effect. The defaults (intent 2000, extract 300, journal 300, companion 500, chat unlimited, ...) are in packages/kernel/src/budgets.ts.
_hands_comment: Who does Gnomon's background jobs (briefs, handoff notes, jobs you ask for). claude: true runs them on your local Claude Code (claude -p, your own login) with only Sundial's read-only MCP, web search and web fetch; no shell, no edits. The job prompt and what Claude reads from your record go to Anthropic. Off by default. claudePath if claude is not on your login shell's PATH; maxBudgetUsd caps one job.
